content: द्रुत {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [द्रु-क्त] .²1 Quick, swift, speedy. .²2 Flown, run away, escaped. .²3 Melted, liquid, dissolved; जातानुरागो द्रुतचित्त उच्चैः <ls>Bhāg. 11. 2. 40</ls>. .²4 Scattered, diffused. .²5 Indistinct. .²6 Moved, softened; द्रुतं करुणया <ls>Māl. 5. 28</ls>; see द्रु. .{@-तः@} .²1 A scorpion. .²2 A tree. .²3 A cat. .{@-तम्@} .²1 the act of running; अलं द्रुतेन वः शूरा इति द्रोणोऽभ्यभाषत <ls>Mb. 7. 16. 18</ls>. .²2 A particular faulty pronunciation of vowels. .{@-तम्@} {%ind.%} Quickly, swiftly, speedily, immediately.
